title: Trace a reported downgrade to version precedence
goal: Upgrading a dependency from 1.0.0-beta.2 to 1.0.0-beta.11 is reported as a downgrade (the test `precedence` fails). Fix version precedence so it follows the Semantic Versioning rules the README describes, without changing existing tests. Run the tests.

context.targeted: Pre-release identifiers are compared in src/version.rs.

acceptance.description: The SemVer specification's example order; numeric identifiers compare numerically and below alphanumeric ones.

expected_failure_modes: string padding instead of numeric comparison
